---
title: "6_Visualisations"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Volcano plots for all primary datasets showing differential
  expression results. Points coloured by direction (Up/Down/NS)
  based on padj < 0.05 only. Dashed lines at log2FC = +/-0.5
  and -log10(0.05) are for visualisation only and do not
  reflect filtering criteria. Top candidate genes labelled.
  Plots saved to Volcano_Plots/.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

dir.create("Volcano_Plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r candidate_genes}
# ============================================================
# TOP CANDIDATE GENES TO LABEL ON VOLCANO PLOTS
# From ALS/PD shared gene set and internal specificity analysis
# ============================================================

top_candidates <- c(
  "MGST3", "RNASEL",                          # Tier 3
  "FOSL1", "TPRG1", "PILRB", "ACSS1",        # Tier 2
  "RFLNA", "SLC40A1", "B3GLCT", "PDE7A",     # Tier 2
  "TNNC1", "MYH7", "TNNT1", "TNNI1",         # Tier 6
  "SOCS3", "KCNN3", "TPM3", "PPP3CC", "PDLIM5" # Tier 5
)
```

```{r volcano_function}
# ============================================================
# VOLCANO PLOT FUNCTION
# Args:
#   df       — DE results dataframe (gene, log2FC, pvalue, padj)
#   gse_id   — dataset ID for title
#   label_genes — genes to label on plot
#   fc_cutoff   — log2FC threshold for dashed lines (vis only)
# ============================================================

make_volcano <- function(df, gse_id,
                         label_genes = top_candidates,
                         fc_cutoff   = 0.5){

  # significance based on padj only — no log2FC filter
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        padj < 0.05 & log2FC >  0 ~ "Up",
        padj < 0.05 & log2FC <  0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE                       ~ "NS"
      ),
      label = ifelse(gene %in% label_genes, gene, NA)
    )

  n_up   <- sum(df$sig == "Up",   na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(df$sig == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x     = log2FC,
                       y     = -log10(pvalue),
                       colour = sig)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    geom_label_repel(
      aes(label = label),
      size         = 3.5,
      max.overlaps = 20,
      na.rm        = TRUE,
      box.padding  = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("Up"   = "#D6604D",
                 "Down" = "#2166AC",
                 "NS"   = "grey70"),
      name   = "Direction"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff),
               linetype   = "dashed",
               colour     = "grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype   = "dashed",
               colour     = "grey40") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title    = paste(gse_id, "Differential Expression"),
      subtitle = paste0("Up: ", n_up, " | Down: ", n_down),
      x        = "log2 Fold Change",
      y        = "-log10(p-value)",
      colour   = "Direction"
    )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r generate_volcano_plots}
# ============================================================
# GENERATE VOLCANO PLOTS FOR ALL PRIMARY DATASETS
# ============================================================

datasets_to_plot <- c(
  "GSE3307",   # ALS primary
  "GSE140089", # PD primary
  "GSE26276",  # ALS directional only
  "GSE122261", # ALS cell line
  "GSE128177", # PD shared cohort
  "GSE30806",  # VCP-myopathy
  "GSE12685",  # AD brain
  "GSE28146"   # AD brain
)

for(gse_id in datasets_to_plot){
  cat("Generating volcano:", gse_id, "\n")

  try({
    de_file <- paste0("DE_Results/", gse_id, "_DE_results.csv")

    if(!file.exists(de_file)){
      cat("DE results not found for:", gse_id, "\n")
      next
    }

    df <- read.csv(de_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    # check for required columns
    if(!all(c("gene","log2FC","pvalue","padj") %in% colnames(df))){
      cat("Missing columns in:", gse_id, "\n")
      next
    }

    p <- make_volcano(df, gse_id)

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("Volcano_Plots/", gse_id, "_volcano.png"),
      plot     = p,
      width    = 10,
      height   = 8,
      dpi      = 300
    )

    cat("Saved:", gse_id, "volcano plot\n")
  })
}

cat("\nAll volcano plots saved to Volcano_Plots/\n")
list.files("Volcano_Plots")
```
